title: About ViRaSPA
intro: ViRaSPA is a minimal, build-free single-page application framework built from vanilla HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
point1: No build step - plain files served by a small Node.js static server.
point2: Page/component lifecycle events, path-based routing, and components with a choice of style isolation.
point3: Write pages and components in 100% native HTML, CSS and JS if you prefer: every framework helper is opt-in.
isolationIntro: A component picks how its styles are isolated: "full" (Shadow DOM), "scoped" (its styles stay inside it, page styles reach in) or "none".
fullText: This card renders in its own shadow root, with the shared base styles adopted into it.
scopedText: This note's styles stay inside it, while the page's link style reaches in:
